/whyTourWorks/sourcing.source_en: Designed as a private Busan shore day for cruise guests using Busan’s main cruise terminals, with route timing planned around port pickup and return.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/items.source_en: Group tours run on a shared clock. A private tour lets the guide plan around your ship's all-aboard time and adjust the last stop if traffic gets heavy.
Busan is spread out, with bridges, coastal roads, hills, and one-way downtown streets. A private vehicle reduces waiting time and keeps the day realistic.
Swap Jagalchi for ⟦G0⟧ Temple, skip the Tower observatory, add the Sky Capsule, or extend lunch — the price is per vehicle, not per change.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/title.source_en: Why a private charter wins for cruise shore days

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.source_en: Private vehicle, English-speaking driver-guide, all toll fees and parking charges. Pickup at cruise terminal / KTX / central Busan hotel.
Lunch (10,000–20,000 KRW p/p), Danubi Train at ⟦G0⟧ (₩4,000), Busan Tower observatory (₩12,000), Sky Capsule if added. All admissions are reasonable — there is no hidden surcharge from us.
Gimhae Airport pickup or drop-off as a separate paid service; overtime at 30,000 KRW per hour cash to driver.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/items.source_en: Full refund if your ship can't dock
If your ship cannot dock in Busan because of weather or port conditions, the tour is eligible for a full refund.
Driver tracks your ship's departure time
We confirm your ship's arrival and all-aboard time, then pace the day against the real port-call schedule.
Vehicle plate number shared in advance
You know exactly which car you're looking for at the terminal arrival hall — no scrambling among the crowds of cruise meet-and-greets.

/routeShapeIntro/body.source_en: The default 5-stop itinerary is shaped for cruise passengers: a quiet, easy-walking start at ⟦G0⟧, a dramatic East Sea moment at ⟦G2⟧, colorful hillside views at Gamcheon, a downtown panorama at Yongdusan, and a lively market finish at Jagalchi. The route can be adjusted at booking with options such as ⟦G1⟧ Temple, the Sky Capsule area, or Beomeosa Temple when time allows.

/routeShapeIntro/title.source_en: Cruise-day rhythm: memorial → cliffs → village → tower → market

/staticQuestions/0/answer.source_en: Sedan or SUV for 1–3 passengers; mid-size van for 4–7 passengers. Larger groups please contact us for a tailored quote.

/staticQuestions/0/question.source_en: How many people can the private vehicle take?

/staticQuestions/1/answer.source_en: If your ship cannot dock at Busan due to weather or port conditions, you receive a full refund. If the ship is simply delayed, the driver waits and adjusts the itinerary; the 8-hour period starts from actual pickup time.

/staticQuestions/1/question.source_en: What if my cruise ship is delayed or cannot dock?

/staticQuestions/2/answer.source_en: Yes — fully. Send your preferred stops at booking and we'll confirm a workable order. The default 5-stop cruise itinerary is a starting point, not a fixed plan. Common substitutions include ⟦G0⟧ Temple, Sky Capsule, and Beomeosa Temple.

/staticQuestions/3/answer.source_en: No — Gimhae Airport pickup or drop-off is a separate paid add-on (not part of the standard cruise-shore period), since the airport is on the western edge of the metropolitan area. Please request at booking and we'll quote the add-on price.

/staticQuestions/3/question.source_en: Is Gimhae Airport pickup or drop-off included?

/seasonalVariations/0/swaps.source_en: Add a Dalmaji Hill cherry blossom drive-by between ⟦G0⟧ and Gamcheon during peak bloom week.

/seasonalVariations/0/summary.source_en: Cherry blossoms peak around late March to early April at Dalmaji Hill, ⟦G0⟧, and Gwangalli Beach. Pleasant 12–22°C; light layers.

/seasonalVariations/1/swaps.source_en: Swap the Tower observatory for the Haeundae Sky Capsule (covered, air-conditioned) or add Songdo Skywalk for a sea breeze.

/seasonalVariations/1/summary.source_en: Warm and humid, 25–32°C, with monsoon showers possible Jun–Jul. Sunset is late, so an extra coastal stop at the end of the day works well.

/seasonalVariations/2/swaps.source_en: All default stops shine in autumn; consider adding Beomeosa Temple for autumn foliage.

/seasonalVariations/2/summary.source_en: Korea's best travel weather — 15–25°C, low humidity, golden light. Cruise season peaks here.

/seasonalVariations/3/swaps.source_en: Limit outdoor time at ⟦G0⟧ lighthouse stairs; add a longer Jagalchi stop where indoor 2F restaurants and hot soup are easy options.

/seasonalVariations/3/summary.source_en: Cool and windy, 0–10°C, but cruise traffic continues. Coastal stops are stark and beautiful.
